title: pilosella tricheilema
intro: Pilosella tricheilema, commonly known as Alpine Mouse Ear, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions, including wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella tricheilema include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions like arthritis and eczema. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
